_comment: Customer offer data per market, read by app/modules/offers/pack.py. Legal values are research, not legal advice: every block ships verified=false with its statutory source. Pack rules warn and never block. Default texts are starting points the company edits. A country absent here gets the neutral block under _default: English titles, no legal notice, no caps, no warnings beyond core.
